source_summary: Tall Chinese landscape with blue-green mountains, misty ravines, clustered architecture, water/lotus surfaces, foreground rocks, pines, and garden pavilions. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: towering_right_mountain
motifs.description: Isolate the large vertical blue-green mountain mass on the upper right, including its stacked rounded peaks, dark shrub-dot ridgelines, sparse pine stands, pale mineral washes, and ink contour striations.
must_preserve: small pine clusters embedded on slopes
soft mist gaps at lower edges

motifs.name: left_saddle_mountain
motifs.description: Isolate the left middle mountain ridge forming the valley wall, with its sloping rounded crest, blue-green wash, dark foliage dots, and pale path-like gullies descending toward the central ravine.
must_preserve: dark tree band along lower edge
pale ravine cut through the slope

motifs.name: hidden_valley_village
motifs.description: Isolate the small architectural cluster tucked in the mountain saddle near the upper center-left, including layered tiled roofs, pale walls, enclosing trees, and the narrow approach path below.
must_preserve: small dark window and roof accents

motifs.name: central_waterfall_ravine
motifs.description: Isolate the central white waterfall and ravine descending between the mountains, with adjacent cliff faces, layered rock ledges, dark foliage borders, and mist-softened lower water.
must_preserve: brown-gray rock ledges crossing the ravine
dark stippled foliage on both sides

motifs.name: foreground_porous_rock_pine
motifs.description: Isolate the large pale foreground rock formation at lower left-center together with the gnarled pine growing across it, including holes in the rock, layered ink texture, exposed roots, and dense pine needles.
must_preserve: dark stippled shrubs at the base

motifs.name: garden_pavilion_group
motifs.description: Isolate the lower right garden architecture: the roofed pavilion, adjacent small house, low walls and terrace, nearby scholar figure, shrubs, and framing trees.
must_preserve: cream walls and red-brown trim accents
blue-green shrubs and branching trees around buildings

motifs.name: lotus_water_surface
motifs.description: Isolate the pale open water area in the lower left and center, including scattered round lotus leaves or floating pads, small stones, soft wash transitions, and shoreline hints without the nearby buildings.

motifs.name: lower_rocky_tree_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the lower right sloping rocky bank with blue-green rocks, leaning trees, bamboo-like foliage, dense shrubs, and the descending hillside that frames the water.
must_preserve: dark stippled moss and shrub dots
layered slope contours and small stones

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
